summary: Layer specifications by altitude: top-level behavior contracts stay short and stable; detail lives in linked lower-level documents loaded on demand (progressive disclosure), keeping both humans and agents able to hold the whole contract.

evidence.summary: 2026 SDD guide: versioned structured specifications as source of truth; community reports 60-80% fewer rework cycles vs prompt-driven development.
GitHub Spec Kit: Specify->Plan->Tasks->Implement workflow; spec is the contract/source of truth for agent work; integrates 30+ agents as of 0.11.0 (2026-06).

writing-for-agents (public, reputation established): read SKILL.md: the 'Information hierarchy' ladder (in-file step -> in-file reference -> disclosed reference reached by a context pointer, loaded only when the pointer fires), 'Progressive disclosure is the move down the ladder ... so the top stays legible', the branching test for what to inline vs disclose, and 'Sprawl' with a 'When to split' section.

not_for: tiny specs already within comfortable context

risks: Wrong layering hides constraints; layer boundaries need review.
